success.description: Ranald hides your true nature and makes you appear as another. You assume the guise of another person, including your clothing and personal effects. The change is only an illusion.

conservative.requirements: With Ranald's favour. You can only assume the guise of a humanoid no smaller than a halfling nor larger than an orc.

success.description: Ranald hides your true nature and makes you appear as another. You assume the guise of another person, including your clothing and personal effects. The change is only an illusion. Attempts to see through your disguise are opposed by your Invocation (Fel).

bane.description: Increase the difficulty modifier by {Dc} if you are unfamiliar with the subject. If you attack another character while disguised, the disguise ends and you gain the Staggered condition for 2 rounds. This blessing recharges at sunrise.

reckless.requirements: You can only assume the guise of a humanoid no smaller than a halfling nor larger than an orc. Special: Reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc} if you are dressed as or already resemble the subject.
